note: San Luis Obispo County park on Santa Margarita Lake, the City of San Luis Obispo's drinking-water reservoir: boating and fishing, no swimming. The drive-in campgrounds are Coyote and Roadrunner on a point at the west cove, Osprey along the shore by the marina, and Grey Pine across the lake road. Bears have been active in the campground; store food securely. --Claude
summary: County page, fee schedule, WebTrac calendar (headless browser, Cloudflare to curl), OSM and imagery read. 60 primitive no-hookup sites (50 drive-in listed online), $38-49, $12 reservation fee. Hookups/fees corrected (stored full-hookup $48-65 belonged to other county parks). Not waterfront kept, Osprey/Roadrunner lead. Rig fit not stated anywhere.
flags: HOOKUPS/FEES CORRECTED: the county page says '60 primitive campsites (no hook-ups)'; the stored water/sewer true (note prose) and $48-65 (the fee schedule's full-hookup and electric tiers, shared with Lopez Lake and El Chorro) do not apply. Santa Margarita's tier is 'Primitive (water only)' $38-49.

RIG FIT UNVERIFIED: no county page or the WebTrac calendar states a site length (site details did not open). RV Life lists it 4*/$$ and imagery shows RVs parked in Osprey and Gray Pine, so nothing suggests a fit problem.
BOOKING WINDOW CONFLICT: the park page says 'reservations can be made up to one year in advance'; the fee schedule 'Reservations are limited to 180 days in advance'. window_opens_days not written.

WATERFRONT LEAD (kept not waterfront): Osprey is a gravel RV strip along the lake north of the marina road, RVs ~15-30 m from the water's edge on imagery, and the Roadrunner loop's west side is ~30-40 m from the cove behind a fringe of shore vegetation. No site numbers or site coordinates are published (WebTrac details did not open), and the lake level against full pool was not checked, so no upgrade; worth a look with a site map.
PIN: the stored 35.3236,-120.4938 sits inside the Gray Pine campground polygon (OSM). The centroid of the four drive-in campgrounds is 35.3259,-120.4939 (~250 m north); move optional.
